scope: Semantic diff, notification gating, deduplication, grouping and write-idempotency rules across all Fortnite monitoring domains

principles.canonical_before_notification: A canonical domain ledger must reflect the new fact before the corresponding change record is reserved for notification, except when the alert itself is the primary record of an external incident and the service ledger transaction is part of the same run.
principles.semantic_not_file_diff: Git file SHA changes are evidence that something may have changed, never sufficient by themselves. Compute domain-specific semantic diffs.
principles.stable_identity: Deduplication keys use stable logical IDs, not titles, localized labels, source URLs with tracking parameters or detection timestamps.
principles.at_most_once: Notification reservation is persisted before emission. Any ambiguous post-reservation recovery suppresses automatic resend.
principles.baseline_safe: Facts present at ledger bootstrap are known history and cannot create a notification unless a new material transition occurs after baseline.
principles.no_notification_from_derived_noise: Pure derived/index/score/readiness/freshness/header changes remain silent unless they alter an actionable canonical decision such as projection level, access action or actual deadline.

non_material_fields: aliases that do not change entity resolution
history append that duplicates an existing semantic history event

LEDGER_ONLY: watch target signal without actionable date
minor physical/access detail with no planning impact
CALENDAR: material VEVENT business change without notification policy eligibility
NOTIFY: only when the domain-specific policy independently marks the material change as user-actionable

required_all: quiet-hour policy does not require defer/suppress
never_notify_for: new Git SHA with same semantics
taxonomy/lore enrichment without future actionable VEVENT impact

exclude: Git commit SHA unless the commit itself is the user-facing subject
notification_key_rules.participant_audience: participant-specific outcomes/reminders use participant_id in audience/scope so one player's result does not suppress another's.

same_subject_examples: ticket availability + new price category for same event
venue exact address + public opening time for same physical event
season start exact time + officially linked downtime announcement
competition session reschedule + corresponding deadline recalculation
coalescing_rules.grouping_output: One user notification may contain multiple change_ids; every member change remains separately auditable.
coalescing_rules.after_reservation: Once a group notification is RESERVED, later changes create a new group/key only if materially distinct; never mutate the already reserved payload in a way that could cause a resend.

supersession_rules.official_correction: Create new change_id and supersedes_change_id. May notify once if actionably different.
supersession_rules.postponed_then_rescheduled: POSTPONED and later TIME_CHANGED are separate material transitions and may each have one distinct notification key.
supersession_rules.sold_out_then_back_on_sale: SOLD_OUT/WAITLIST and BACK_ON_SALE are distinct changes; each can notify once when policy permits.
supersession_rules.cancelled_then_reactivated: CANCELLED and reactivation are distinct; do not let the cancellation key suppress reactivation.
supersession_rules.same_value_reobserved: No new change unless new official evidence establishes a genuine new transition back to that value.

reservation_and_delivery.unknown_delivery: No automatic retry. Prefer a missed alert over a duplicate.
reservation_and_delivery.parallel_run_guard: After computing a candidate key, re-fetch the change ledger and reserve only if no terminal receipt exists for that key.
reservation_and_delivery.manual_recovery: Only explicit user/admin intervention or machine-verifiable proof that no delivery occurred may reset UNKNOWN_DELIVERY/RESERVED for retry.

write_dedupe.canonical_ledger: Write only when post-write semantic fingerprint differs from current canonical semantic fingerprint. checked_at alone never writes.
write_dedupe.calendar: Write only when projected VEVENT business fingerprint differs. Formatting/folding/DTSTAMP-only changes do not increment SEQUENCE.
write_dedupe.crash_after_write: Fresh-fetch target and recompute fingerprint before any retry; if desired semantic state is already present, record/repair write receipt and skip duplicate commit.
write_dedupe.change_ledger_self_write: Appending a new change/receipt is itself allowed and must not recursively create another user-facing CALENDAR_PROJECTION change.

recovery.restart: Read ledger + terminal key index before processing any domain notifications.
recovery.orphan_pending: PENDING without reservation may be safely re-evaluated against current canonical facts; if still eligible, reserve same key, otherwise suppress/cancel before send.
recovery.unknown_commit: Inspect repository target state. Never blindly replay write or notification.

index_policy.notification_key_index: Exact map from notification_key to receipt_id. It is an acceleration structure, but receipt records remain canonical.
index_policy.rebuild: If key index diverges from receipts, rebuild index from receipts; never delete a receipt to satisfy the index.
index_policy.collision: Any duplicate notification_key with different semantic payload is a validation failure.

ics_policy.header_only: Add only on next real business write; no SEQUENCE increment for headers alone.
ics_policy.privacy: Never serialize notification receipt IDs, delivery state or internal reservation IDs into public ICS files.
